lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: Parkinson, you would not recognise loyalty if it bit you. That parchment belongs to me and you will return it before anyone else sees a single line.
lines.expression: wand raised steady, jaw locked, eyes darting to the heavy greenhouse door

lines.speaker: Pansy Parkinson
lines.text: Father's owl reaches Lucius before dawn unless you hand over the Slytherin prefect badge tomorrow. Consider it insurance for my silence.
lines.emotion: smug satisfaction laced with sharp warning
lines.expression: parchment held high between two fingers, lips curled, weight shifted to her back foot
